description: Skill Radar — skill observability hooks (Trae). TEMPLATE, not loaded by Trae directly: Trae has no plugin-level hooks, so install-trae.js substitutes ${TRAE_PLUGIN_ROOT} with the installed plugin root at install time and merges the hooks map into the project-level .trae/hooks.json (preferred, --project-only) or the global ~/.trae-cn/hooks.json (explicit --global only). Own entries are identified by the 'skill-radar-trae' path marker for idempotent re-install and uninstall. Trae runs command hooks in the system default shell (PowerShell on Windows); timeout is in seconds. All hooks are observability-only: they exit 0 on any error and never block, so no Stop loop_limit risk.
